title: geranium suaveolens
intro: Geranium suaveolens, commonly known as Old Rose Geranium, is a species of flowering plant that belongs to the Geraniaceae family. This plant is known for its sweet and rose-like fragrance, and is often used in aromatherapy and herbal medicine. The health benefits of Geranium suaveolens include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve mood and sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including geraniol, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, which have anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular natural remedy for various health issues.
